runs.text: Splitting a single model distributes its weights across two machines to run one unified system, whereas running two independent models creates two separate systems with distinct parameters. The split model shares a single knowledge base and produces consistent outputs, while independent models operate as separate entities that may generate different results. This approach optimizes hardware utilization for one
